title: 3790. Smallest All-Ones Multiple

examples.explanation: n = 111 because 111 is divisible by 3, but 1 and 11 are not. The length of n = 111 is 3.
n = 111111. The length of n = 111111 is 6.
There does not exist a valid n that is a multiple of 2.
